$comment: Machine-readable manifest of the Brainarbeit MCP tools. Each tool maps to a one-contract verb, proxied through the authenticated gateway (durable token + mandatory TOTP 2FA, broker act-as, cap-intersection). An MCP-capable LLM/agent drives the Brainbox by calling these. Trigger conditions are written into each description (prescriptive when-to-call) so conservative models still reach for them.

server.name: brainarbeit
server.description: Drive a Brainarbeit Brainbox and receive its reality as MCP tools.

tools.name: brainarbeit_submit
tools.description: Hand a task to the Brainbox. Call this whenever the user wants real work done that the box can run autonomously: fill a form, run an HPC/compute pipeline, prepare a shipping/customs document, write an application (Antrag), answer emails, operate an app. Submits a TYPED task (task_type + params); raw shell commands are not accepted. Attach files inline (base64) or reference files already on the box. Returns a job id; the box works it and notifies on completion. If the task_type has an approval gate, the job parks until you call brainarbeit_resolve_approval.

task_type.description: the server-side typed task template to run

attachments.description: files to upload; staged on the box and passed to the job as path refs

path_refs.description: files already on the box (e.g. a discovered share)

needs_confirmation.description: force a human approval gate before any side effect

tools.name: brainarbeit_status
tools.description: Check on a job you submitted. Call this when the user asks whether a task is done, in progress, queued, or waiting for approval. Returns the Canonical View Model: state, queue position, progress, latest events.

tools.name: brainarbeit_result
tools.description: Fetch the typed result of a finished job (artifacts, verdict, confidence). Call this once a job is done to retrieve what it produced.

tools.name: brainarbeit_list_jobs
tools.description: List the caller's jobs. Call this when the user asks 'what's running', 'show my tasks', or wants an overview. Optionally filter by state (queued/running/awaiting_approval/done/failed).

tools.name: brainarbeit_pending_approvals
tools.description: List jobs waiting for the human's yes. Call this when the user asks what needs approval, or before deciding whether to approve/reject. Each item carries the nonce to pass to brainarbeit_resolve_approval and a summary of the about-to-happen side effect.

tools.name: brainarbeit_resolve_approval
tools.description: Approve, reject, revise, or deny a job's approval gate. Call this to let an irreversible action fire (approve), block it but keep the artifact (reject), re-run with feedback (revise), or cancel a pre-dispatch staged job (deny). Nonce-gated and idempotent. NEVER approve on the user's behalf without their explicit yes.

nonce.description: from brainarbeit_pending_approvals or the submit response

tools.name: brainarbeit_steer
tools.description: Send live feedback into a RUNNING job. Call this when the user wants to nudge, correct, or add information to a task that is currently in progress (not queued, not finished).

input.description: the steering message/data to feed the worker

tools.name: brainarbeit_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a queued or running job. Call this when the user wants to stop a task.

tools.name: brainarbeit_outputs
tools.description: List the outputs the caller's jobs have emitted (results, files, artifacts). Call this when the user asks for everything the box has produced for them.

tools.name: brainarbeit_engine_status
tools.description: Get the box's governor/queue snapshot: how busy it is, queued/running counts, reserved RAM, memory pressure. Call this when the user asks how loaded the box is or whether it has capacity.
